| `SimulatorView.java` | GUI frame with Swing components, nested `FieldView` inner class for visualization |
| `Field.java` | 2D grid representation (depth x width), stores objects via GridSpace; manages location queries and adjacency |
| `GridSpace.java` | Cell container holding one Animal and one Plant per location |
| `LivingOrganism.java` | Abstract base with shared state (alive, field, location, foodValue); defines act/setDead/populate contract |
| `Animal.java` | Abstract extension - adds age, breeding, hunger, infection/immunity mechanics; handles movement and disease propagation |
| `Plant.java` | Concrete plant with health percentage, weather-dependent spreading, partial eating |
| `Predator.java` | Abstract carnivore - hunts Prey, affected by time/weather; high movement probability (0.8) |

| `Location.java` | Value object: (row, col) with equals/hashCode for grid positioning |
| `Randomizer.java` | Static utility: configurable seeded/unseeded Random source |
| `Counter.java` | Simple counter: name + count for population statistics |
| `FieldStats.java` | Statistics aggregator: population tallying, viability checks (>1 species alive) |
